chunks: If a mountain were to oppress another mountain, Allah would crush it to dust.

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One who judges and punishes wrongdoing
key_terms.جَبَلٌ: a mountain, used here as a striking image of strength
key_terms.دَكًّا: crushed flat, reduced to dust or rubble

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about oppression and Allah’s justice?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that oppression is so grave that even if it were imagined between mountains, Allah would destroy the aggressor. It emphasizes divine justice and warns against transgression and ظلم.
